expected_architecture: DISCOVERY_ENGINE → TECHNOLOGY_FABRIC → BUYER_PACKAGE → CEO → BUYER → BUYER_EXPERIMENT → INBOUND_PIPELINE → LEARNING_ENGINE → NEW_DISCOVERY

DISCOVERY_ENGINE.role: Generate candidates from problem space + cemetery constraints

TECHNOLOGY_FABRIC.role: Mechanism, model, evidence, economics, differentiation, transfer

BUYER_PACKAGE.role: What the CEO hands to the buyer

BUYER.role: Evaluates package, runs experiment, returns data

BUYER_EXPERIMENT.role: Physical bench test / clinical study / wet lab

INBOUND_PIPELINE.role: Ingest external experimental data with provenance + custody chain

LEARNING_ENGINE.role: Update posterior from external evidence → recompute EIG → select next experiment

NEW_DISCOVERY.role: Generate next candidate set informed by what was learned
